array_axes: base_pair vectors receive edited-slot summaries. Factor spectra, slot ranks and atom means retain their index axes. Component indices are local to each root, so their elementwise means stay in per_root.

gauge_scope.atom_energy: Invariant under reciprocal V-column/U-row scaling and sign changes; within-block mixing can redistribute atom energy.
gauge_scope.coordinate_reads: Read-coordinate norms depend on the factor gauge.
gauge_scope.grouped_physical_writes: Invariant under invertible factor basis changes preserving the selected/outside partition of the measured case.
gauge_scope.solver: Condition numbers and numerical rank use the supplied factor representation and declared singular-value cutoff.

measurement_scope.atom_means: Means of component squared write norms in the saved factor gauge
measurement_scope.calculation: Reductions of hashed saved receipts; raw arrays remain in those receipts
measurement_scope.counterfactual_state: Hybrid-derived directions use privileged counterfactual states
measurement_scope.directions: Cast state edits at the declared physical state dose
measurement_scope.pathway_final_all_head_delta_norm: Norm across value logits for each base receiver's original query; expanded all-address outcomes are recorded separately.
measurement_scope.pathways: Parent state edit determines each route's inherited write dose
